newsitem.title: UK: Credit Lyonnais head resists further change - paper.
newsitem.headline: Credit Lyonnais head resists further change - paper.

text.p: The chairman of Credit Lyonnais suggested in an interview published by the Financial Times on Monday he would resign if the European Commission forced him to sell off more of the bank's activities.
Jean Peyrelevade said it was essential to keep businesses such as capital markets operations in New York or Tokyo.
This was important to maintain operating profits at a necessary minimum of at least 8.0 billion French francs ($1.40 billion) to 9.0 billion French francs ($1.58 billion) a year, he said.

His comments came ahead of a submission by the French government in the next few weeks to the European competition authorities in Brussels of a privatisation plan which could cost up to 30 billion French francs ($5.26 billion).
